tickets.title: Open new client account
tickets.text: Open a jointly registered brokerage account at Velvet Acorn Custody for Rowan Bramblequill and Lila Nettlewhisk to receive monthly surplus from the new household checking arrangement at Teacup Comet Bank, while keeping each spouse's existing retirement accounts separate.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to set up the joint taxable account, with follow-up due July 12, 2024.

tickets.title: Obtain marriage documentation for account records
tickets.text: Obtain Rowan Bramblequill and Lila Nettlewhisk's marriage certificate and Lila's identification details so Velvet Acorn Custody can add Lila to jointly held account paperwork and household-level profile records.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the marriage documentation for account records by June 28, 2024.

tickets.title: Complete marriage-based beneficiary review
tickets.text: Review beneficiary designations across Rowan Bramblequill's IRA, Roth IRA, Copper Firefly Design Studio retirement plan, Silver Marmot Insurance $750,000 term life policy, and employer-paid group life coverage following the June 8, 2024 marriage to Lila Nettlewhisk, using current beneficiary records as starting evidence.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to complete that marriage-based beneficiary review by July 17, 2024.

tickets.title: Guide benefits enrollment decision and submission
tickets.text:
Use this workflow when a client needs support reviewing available benefits, selecting appropriate coverage, and confirming enrollment completion. Keep recommendations coordinated with the client’s broader financial plan, tax considerations, and liquidity needs.

Compare Rowan Bramblequill's Copper Firefly Design Studio health, dental, vision, HSA, disability, life insurance, and payroll deduction choices against Lila Nettlewhisk's available Moonbadger Animal Clinic coverage before making elections during the post-marriage enrollment window.

subTasks.title: Collect benefits materials and key enrollment constraints
subTasks.text: Request the current benefits guide, plan comparison sheets, premium schedule, employer contribution details, enrollment window, and any life event documentation needed for eligibility.

subTasks.title: Review plan fit and planning tradeoffs
subTasks.text: Compare health, disability, life insurance, HSA/FSA, retirement plan, deferred compensation, and equity-related elections as applicable. Note cash flow impact, tax implications, beneficiary needs, and coordination with existing coverage.

subTasks.title: Prepare enrollment recommendations for client discussion
subTasks.text: Summarize proposed elections, open questions, documents needed, and any items requiring confirmation from the employer benefits team or outside tax professional.

subTasks.title: Confirm submission and retain evidence
subTasks.text: After the client submits elections, request confirmation pages or benefit summaries and save them to the client record for future planning reference.

tickets.evidence: They agreed to the employer benefits election review, with follow-up due July 10, 2024.

tickets.title: Reconcile equity vesting records
tickets.text: Reconcile the restricted stock unit vesting cadence between Rowan Bramblequill's personal spreadsheet and the Copper Firefly Design Studio equity portal export to confirm projected cash flow and tax withholding estimates for the combined household plan.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to reconcile the equity vesting records by July 22, 2024.

tickets.title: Resolve custodian address and portal access issue
tickets.text: Resolve the issue where prior online address changes did not appear on recent Velvet Acorn Custody statements and ensure Lila Nettlewhisk receives the household portal invitation email before combining the couple's records.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to address the custodian address and portal access issue by July 3, 2024.

tickets.title: Coordinate estate document updates
tickets.text: Coordinate updates to Rowan Bramblequill's estate documents, which predate the June 8, 2024 marriage to Lila Nettlewhisk and do not reflect Lila's role, the Portland townhouse and Salem condo, or the desired decision-makers for financial and health care matters. Original documents were prepared by Paper Otter Legal Group.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to estate document coordination by August 2, 2024.

tickets.title: Send address and residency update outreach
tickets.text:
Outreach outline:
Subject: Confirming address and residency update for Rowan Bramblequill

Hello Rowan Bramblequill,

We understand you may need to update your mailing address, legal residence, or tax residency information. To help us keep your records current, please confirm the following:

- New mailing address: [ADDRESS]
- Effective date of address change: [DATE]
- Is this also your legal residence? [YES / NO]
- Prior state or jurisdiction: [PRIOR LOCATION]
- New state or jurisdiction: [NEW LOCATION]
- Any expected change to employment location, withholding, or state tax filing: [DETAILS]
- Accounts, statements, or documents that should use a different mailing address: [DETAILS]
- CPA or attorney to include, if any: [CONTACT NAME AND EMAIL]

Once confirmed, we will review required custodian forms, update internal records, and coordinate any planning follow-up related to taxes, estate documents, or account restrictions.

Thank you,
[TEAM MEMBER NAME]

Coordinate with CPA Sasha Cloudpuddle on the Oregon-to-Washington move, including mailing address, legal residence, payroll withholding, and how the Portland townhouse and Salem condo should be reflected in planning records.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to residency and tax coordination, with follow-up due July 26, 2024.
